title: Car Domain — Vertical Relationships
description: Demonstrates vertical (hierarchical/embedded) has-one and has-many relationships. A Car physically contains its Motor (has-one vertical) and its Wheels (has-many vertical, fixed count). The vertical/horizontal choice is made on each property of Car; it does not restrict how Motor or Wheel may be used by other source types.

Motor.title: Motor
Motor.description: An internal combustion engine. In this schema it is embedded vertically inside Car, but the type definition itself does not restrict it to vertical use.

Wheel.title: Wheel
Wheel.description: A single wheel fitted to a car. In this schema it is embedded vertically inside Car's wheel array, but the type definition itself does not restrict it to vertical use.

Car.title: Car
Car.description: A car that owns its Motor (has-one vertical) and exactly four Wheels (has-many vertical, fixed count 4).

motor.description: HAS-ONE VERTICAL: the Motor is embedded in the Car JSON. It is owned by and validated as part of this Car.

wheels.description: HAS-MANY VERTICAL (fixed count): exactly four Wheel objects embedded in the Car JSON. The Wheels are owned by and validated as part of this Car.
